# Delta Flow

> Delta Flow is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) agency based in Karachi, Pakistan. It helps brands become easier for AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude to understand, trust and mention.

Delta Flow focuses only on GEO and AEO. It does not guarantee placement in AI-generated answers, because no one can. Work is based on clear structure, consistent brand information and trusted online presence.

## Services

- AI visibility audit: testing what ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude say about a brand today
- Answer-first content: pages and FAQs written so AI tools can use them as direct answers
- Structured data: FAQ, Organization and business schema markup
- Brand consistency: same name, descriptions and details across websites and profiles
- Authority building: citations and trusted mentions across the web
- Re-testing: checking AI answers again after changes
